scripts.build: bun run --filter @quip/frontend build && bun run verify:no-polkadot-in-bundle
scripts.verify:no-polkadot-in-bundle: if grep -rq '@polkadot' apps/frontend/dist/assets/ 2>/dev/null; then echo 'FAIL: @polkadot/* leaked into the SPA bundle. The substrate worker is indexer-only — never import @polkadot/* from the frontend.' >&2; exit 1; fi
scripts.typecheck: for w in @quip/shared @quip/core @quip/server @quip/indexer @quip/frontend; do bun run --filter "$w" typecheck || exit 1; done && tsc --noEmit
